vulnerability.name: USN-9017-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that libgphoto2 did not properly manage memory when initializing certain cameras. If a user were tricked into connecting a malicious USB device, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause libgphoto2 to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-120451)  It was discovered that libgphoto2 did not properly manage memory when processing certain thumbnails. If a user were tricked into connecting a malicious USB device, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause libgphoto2 to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or expose sensitive information. (CVE-2026-120452)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in libgphoto2.
